brd: brd/RD_Core Colors Toggle in Colors By Brand Page.docx

requirements.title: Reskin feature flag in ENV file
requirements.description: The Customizer Reskin feature shall be controlled by a feature control setting in the ENV file.

requirements.title: Customizer process flow
requirements.description: The process flow shall be Customizer Landing Page, Sports Picker, Product Picker, Builder Page.

requirements.title: Hide nav header in builder
requirements.description: The navigation header shall not be displayed if the user is already in the Builder.

requirements.title: Reskin cart and approval roster modal
requirements.description: If Customizer Reskin is turned on, the Shopping Cart and approval page roster modal shall also be reskinned.

requirements.title: Back to Sport from picker
requirements.description: For any action in the Picker page that opens the builder, a "Back to <Sport>" link shall be displayed.

requirements.title: Back to Sport restores filters and team
requirements.description: Clicking "Back to <Sport>" shall return to the Picker page with the applied filters and team details, if any (sticky feature).

requirements.title: Back to Cart from shopping cart
requirements.description: For any action in the shopping cart that opens the builder, a "Back to Cart" link shall be displayed and clicking it shall return to the Shopping Cart.

requirements.title: Back to Saved Designs link
requirements.description: For any action in the Saved Designs page that opens the builder, a "Back to Saved Designs" link shall be displayed and clicking it shall return to the user's Saved Designs page.

requirements.title: Back to PDF File link
requirements.description: When the URL builder is accessed from the PDF file, a "Back to PDF File" link shall be displayed and clicking it shall return to the previously opened PDF file.

requirements.title: Back to Cart from Approval Page
requirements.description: When the URL Builder is accessed from the Approval Page, a "Back to Cart" link shall be displayed and clicking it shall return the user to the Shopping Cart.

requirements.title: Back to Sport from external URL builder
requirements.description: When the URL Builder is accessed from anywhere outside the Customizer, a "Back to <Sport>" link shall be displayed and clicking it shall return the user to the Picker Page filtered by the sport of the uniform.

requirements.title: Undo reverts previous action
requirements.description: Clicking Undo shall revert the previous action.

requirements.title: Undo redirects to affected tab
requirements.description: After clicking Undo, the user shall be redirected to the tab or section where the last action was undone.

requirements.title: Undo disabled on load
requirements.description: Undo shall be disabled when the builder first loads, including when a saved design is revisited.

requirements.title: Redo restores previous change
requirements.description: Clicking Redo shall restore the previous change.

requirements.title: Redo redirects to affected tab
requirements.description: After clicking Redo, the user shall be redirected to the tab or section where the last action was reapplied.

requirements.title: Redo disabled on load
requirements.description: Redo shall be disabled when the builder first loads, including when a saved design is revisited.

requirements.title: Save opens Save and Share UI
requirements.description: Clicking the Save button shall display the new Save and Share UI.

requirements.title: Save requires design name and notes entry
requirements.description: In the Save and Share UI the user shall enter a Design name and Notes.

requirements.title: Save Design generates ID and enables share
requirements.description: Clicking Save Design shall populate the ID number, enable all share functionalities below Notes, and change the Save Design button to Done.

requirements.title: Done saves design and header becomes Update
requirements.description: Clicking Done shall save the design and change the header Save button to Update.

requirements.title: Update reopens Save and Share modal
requirements.description: When the user clicks Update, the Save and Share modal shall reopen.

requirements.title: Rename shows Save as New
requirements.description: When the user updates the Design Name, the Close and Done buttons shall automatically change to Close, Save as New and Update.

requirements.title: Save as New creates new ID
requirements.description: Save as New shall create a new ID number and display the Close and Done buttons.

requirements.title: Share view icon
requirements.description: The View icon in Share shall redirect to the Save Design page.

requirements.title: Share download opens modal
requirements.description: The Download icon shall open the Download Images modal.

requirements.title: Download multi-select
requirements.description: The user shall be able to select multiple items to be downloaded in the Download Images modal.

requirements.title: Download options for regular
requirements.description: Download options shall include All views as one image, Front and back as one image, Front View, Back View, Left View and Right View.

requirements.title: Download options for reversible
requirements.description: For reversible uniforms, download options shall be provided per side (Side A and Side B) for All views as one image, Front and back as one image, Front, Back, Left and Right views.

requirements.title: Download triggers local download
requirements.description: Clicking Download shall open the local machine download functionality.

requirements.title: Download file type png
requirements.description: The downloaded image file type shall be .png.

requirements.title: Download file name format
requirements.description: The downloaded file name shall be "Design Name_<Downloaded View>.png" (e.g. Design Name_all-views.png).

requirements.title: Multiple images zipped
requirements.description: If the user selects multiple images, they shall be downloaded as a zip file named after the Design Name.

requirements.title: Share View PDF
requirements.description: View PDF shall open the PDF of the style in a new tab.

requirements.title: Share via Email
requirements.description: Share shall provide a Share via Email option.

requirements.title: Share Link copies builder URL
requirements.description: Share Link shall copy the URL builder.

requirements.title: Add to Cart opens modal
requirements.description: Clicking Add to Cart shall open the "Add Item to Cart" modal.

requirements.title: Create Cart adds item
requirements.description: Clicking Create Cart shall automatically add the item to the cart.

requirements.title: Item Added to Cart modal displayed
requirements.description: Once the cart is created, the "Item Added to Cart" modal shall display "This item has been added to your cart. What would you like to do next?".

requirements.title: Go to Cart redirects
requirements.description: Go to Cart shall redirect the user to the Shopping Cart.

requirements.title: Return to Customizer from picker
requirements.description: If the user came from the picker page, Return to Customizer shall redirect to the picker page with filters and team details applied (current sticky filter behavior).

requirements.title: Return to Saved Designs from saved designs
requirements.description: If the user came from saved designs, the Return to Customizer button shall change to "Return to Saved Designs" and redirect to the Saved Designs page.

requirements.title: Return to Customizer from external URL
requirements.description: If the user came from the URL Builder outside the Customizer or other pages, Return to Customizer shall redirect to the Picker Page filtered by the uniform's sport.

requirements.title: Update Item button from cart
requirements.description: The Add to Cart button shall change to "Update Item" when the user opens the builder from the Shopping Cart.

requirements.title: Canvas product info displayed
requirements.description: The style canvas shall display the product name, style name, product functionality type, estimated ship date and Youth/Mens price range.

requirements.title: Thumbnail update on click
requirements.description: Product view thumbnails shall be updated upon clicking different perspectives, another tab (Details, Options, Customize, Application, Roster, Summary) or the Save button.

requirements.title: Thumbnail disclaimer message
requirements.description: A disclaimer "Thumbnails update when you switch tabs." shall be displayed at the bottom of the Product Views.

requirements.title: Details tab info fields
requirements.description: The Details tab shall display Price Item, Product Line, Block, Style, Gender, Youth, Adult, Sizing Chart Link and How to Measure.

requirements.title: Materials fabric options with details
requirements.description: The Materials section shall show all fabric options with Fabric Name (Suggested), Image, Content, Weight and Construction/Function/Features.

requirements.title: Fabric image opens modal
requirements.description: Fabric images in the Details tab shall be clickable and open a modal.

requirements.title: Intended Fit image modal
requirements.description: The Intended Fit image shall be clickable and open a modal.

requirements.title: Decoration section and video
requirements.description: The Details tab shall show Decoration with a video, if any, and a decoration thumbnail modal.

requirements.title: Video modal autoplay
requirements.description: When the user clicks the video thumbnail, a video modal shall display and the video shall play automatically.

requirements.title: Options tab default landing
requirements.description: The Options tab shall be the default landing page when the uniform first loads in the builder.

requirements.title: Options tab fabric options
requirements.description: The Options tab shall include Fabric options with a Fabric header label, Body Part Group (e.g. Body, Panel) and Fabric details.

requirements.title: Fabric content info tooltip
requirements.description: Hovering over the information icon on Fabric Content shall display a tooltip modal with Fabric Name, Image, Content, Weight and Construction/Function/Features.

requirements.title: Fabric upgrade charge displayed
requirements.description: The fabric upgrade charge shall be displayed (+$xx.xx/item) if an applicable fee exists.

requirements.title: Fabric upgrade charge in Summary
requirements.description: The fabric upgrade charge shall be automatically added in the Summary tab.

requirements.title: Add to cart without fabric selected
requirements.description: The system shall allow adding an item to the cart without a fabric selected (see BRD_ABILITY TO ADD AN ITEM TO THE CART WITHOUT A FABRIC SELECTED).

requirements.title: Reversible options fabric message
requirements.description: For reversible uniforms, the Options tab shall display below the Fabric header "Fabric selection will be applied to both Side A and Side B".

requirements.title: Organization section visibility
requirements.description: The Organization section shall be present only if the brand has active team database functionality; otherwise the dropdown shall not be present and Colors In Use shall be the top-most section.

requirements.title: Organization dropdown lists linked orgs
requirements.description: The Organization dropdown shall display all organizations (teams) linked to the user.

requirements.title: Organization item details
requirements.description: Each organization dropdown item shall contain Image, Organization Name and Location Details.

requirements.title: Organization dropdown acts as filter
requirements.description: The Organization dropdown shall function as a filter (typing "As" filters teams that start with "As").

requirements.title: Org change shows Colors In Use modal
requirements.description: If the user selects another organization, the Colors In Use modal shall be displayed with the message "The colors for <organization selected> are different from your current Colors In Use. Choose which colors you'd like to use:".

requirements.title: Org modal color choices
requirements.description: The Colors In Use modal shall show New Color tiles with checkbox (default selected) and Current Color tiles with checkbox.

requirements.title: Org modal Cancel
requirements.description: Cancel in the Colors In Use organization modal shall cancel the action and apply no changes.

requirements.title: Org modal Continue
requirements.description: Continue in the Colors In Use organization modal shall update the colors in use list and apply to the parts.

requirements.title: Org modal variants for color counts
requirements.description: The Colors In Use modal shall support equal, unequal and large number of colors scenarios.

requirements.title: Colors Unavailable modal
requirements.description: Upon Continue, if the new organization has colors not available in the selected style, a "Colors Unavailable" modal shall be displayed allowing the user to replace them; clicking Update Colors shall close the modal and update Colors In Use.

requirements.title: Org with fewer than 2 colors requires one more
requirements.description: If the new organization has fewer than 2 colors, the user shall select one more color before updating the organization.

requirements.title: Org with no colors skips modal
requirements.description: If the new organization has no colors, the Colors In Use modal shall not be displayed and the organization shall simply change.

requirements.title: Colors In Use default display
requirements.description: Colors In Use shall display the default colors of the uniform on load, or the colors applied from the Picker page.

requirements.title: Color tile opens color picker
requirements.description: Clicking a color tile shall display the color picker below the selected section.

requirements.title: Core Colors and Additional Colors
requirements.description: The color picker shall classify colors into Core Colors (brand-determined) and Additional Colors (all others).

requirements.title: Colors label when no core colors
requirements.description: If there are no Core Colors, the picker shall only show "Colors".

requirements.title: Core colors info icon
requirements.description: An info icon shall provide a color guide that opens a full modal (TBC), driven by a new QX7 config and hardcoded for now.

requirements.title: Twill color availability
requirements.description: Some colors shall not be available on Twill products.

requirements.title: Color change propagates to same-color parts
requirements.description: When the user changes a color, all parts with the same color shall be updated to the new color.

requirements.title: Color tile hover name
requirements.description: Hovering over a color tile shall display the color name.

requirements.title: Add color via plus button
requirements.description: Clicking "+" in Colors In Use shall display the color picker.

requirements.title: Single color selection at a time
requirements.description: The user shall be able to select only 1 color at a time when adding a color.

requirements.title: Colors In Use limit 15
requirements.description: Colors In Use shall be limited to 15 colors.

requirements.title: Remove color if unused
requirements.description: Clicking "x" on a color tile shall remove the color from Colors In Use if it is not applied to any part or application.

requirements.title: Minimum colors modal
requirements.description: If only 2 colors remain and the user tries to remove one, the "Colors In Use Minimum Colors" modal shall display ("A minimum of two colors is required for customization. Please choose a replacement color") requiring cancel or replace.

requirements.title: Remove Color modal for applied color
requirements.description: If the user removes a color applied to parts or applications, the Remove Color modal shall display "This color is being used on {Style Part 1}, {Style Part 2} and {Application Name}. Please choose a replacement color."

requirements.title: Remove Color modal elements
requirements.description: The Remove Color modal shall show Current Color Name + Color Tile and a Choose Color button, which opens the color picker for a replacement.

requirements.title: Remove Color modal Cancel
requirements.description: Cancel in the Remove Color modal shall cancel the action with no changes.

requirements.title: Remove Color modal Update Colors
requirements.description: Update Colors shall update the Colors In Use list and the related part colors.

requirements.title: Update Colors without selection highlights red
requirements.description: If the user clicks Update Colors without selecting a color, the button shall be highlighted in red to indicate a selection is required.

requirements.title: Replace color with existing removes original
requirements.description: When the user updates a color tile to a color already in the list, the original tile shall be removed (e.g. replacing White with Pink in White, Blue, Orange, Pink yields Pink, Blue, Orange).

requirements.title: Replace color updates all usages
requirements.description: When a color is replaced, all parts (including patterns, piping, applications) that had the old color shall be updated to the new color, and parts already using the existing color remain unchanged.

requirements.title: Parts list display
requirements.description: Parts shall be listed with Part Name, Color Name and Color Tile.

requirements.title: Part hover highlights canvas
requirements.description: Hovering a part name shall highlight the corresponding part on the uniform canvas.

requirements.title: Long color name truncated
requirements.description: A color name that exceeds the available space shall be truncated.

requirements.title: Part color overlay
requirements.description: Hovering a part color tile shall display the Colors in Use overlay for selecting the part's color.

requirements.title: Canvas updates on part color change
requirements.description: Once the user updates a part color, the uniform canvas shall be updated accordingly.

requirements.title: Brand Logo section display
requirements.description: The Brand Logo section shall display a "Brand Logo" label, Color Name and Color Tile.

requirements.title: Multiple brand logos labels
requirements.description: If there are multiple brand logos they shall be labeled Brand Logo 1 and Brand Logo 2.

requirements.title: Brand Logo location dropdown
requirements.description: A Location dropdown shall show all applicable locations for the brand logo.

requirements.title: No Logo option with add-on
requirements.description: If the uniform has a "Remove Brand Logo" add-on, the Location dropdown shall include "No Logo +$XX per item" as the last option.

requirements.title: No Logo hides color tile
requirements.description: If "No Logo" is selected, no color tile shall be displayed.

requirements.title: Brand logo color overlay with plus
requirements.description: Hovering a Brand Logo color tile shall display the Colors in Use overlay with a "+" button.

requirements.title: Brand logo additional trim colors
requirements.description: Clicking "+" shall display the Additional Trim Colors section with only the color options available for the selected Brand Logo.

requirements.title: Brand logo color applied and added to in use
requirements.description: Selecting a color from Additional Trim Colors shall apply it to the Brand Logo and add it to Colors in Use.

requirements.title: Brand logo color removal independent
requirements.description: Removing a color via "x" for a Brand Logo shall remove it only from the Brand Logo Colors In Use section (trims act as independent entities).

requirements.title: Add Piping button
requirements.description: The Customize tab shall provide an Add Piping button.

requirements.title: Add Pattern switches panel
requirements.description: The Add Pattern button shall switch the Colors panel to the Patterns functionality.

requirements.title: Reversible combined Colors In Use
requirements.description: Colors In Use for reversible shall display the combined colors of both sides, with a single set of Colors In Use for both sides.

requirements.title: Reversible default color order
requirements.description: Side A default colors shall be displayed first, followed by Side B default colors.

requirements.title: Reversible no duplicate colors
requirements.description: Duplicate colors shall not be displayed in reversible Colors In Use.

requirements.title: Reversible color update both sides
requirements.description: Changing or updating Colors In Use shall update the corresponding parts on both sides.

requirements.title: Remove same-body-part-color rule
requirements.description: The existing reversible rule preventing the other side from having the same body part color shall be removed (Find and Replace Colors In Use applies).

requirements.title: Reversible organization updates both sides
requirements.description: If the user selects an organization, selected colors on both sides shall also be updated.

requirements.title: Reversible color removal flow
requirements.description: Removing a color in reversible shall follow the "Removing a color via x button" flow.

requirements.title: Reversible side parts display
requirements.description: Each side tab shall display parts as Part Name, Color Name and Color Tile.

requirements.title: Reversible link icon tooltip
requirements.description: If parts must have the same color on both sides, a link icon shall be displayed with the tooltip "The color must be the same on both sides".

requirements.title: Reversible same color on linked parts
requirements.description: Colors selected on both sides shall be the same on the same (linked) parts.

requirements.title: Reversible per-side brand logo
requirements.description: The user shall be able to select a different brand logo configuration for each side.

requirements.title: Reversible No Logo both sides
requirements.description: When both sides have a brand logo configured and the user selects "No Logo" on one side, the other side shall also be updated to "No Logo" and charged as one add-on.

requirements.title: Reversible No Logo single side
requirements.description: When only one side is configured with "No Logo", only that side shall be affected by the add-on.

requirements.title: Reversible brand logo canvas update
requirements.description: When the brand logo changes, the canvas shall be updated accordingly.

requirements.title: Reversible side tab syncs canvas
requirements.description: When the user switches the side tab, the corresponding side in the canvas shall be selected.

requirements.title: Reversible Add Text same as regular
requirements.description: Add Text for reversible shall use the same flow/behavior as the regular uniform.

requirements.title: Reversible Add Logo same as regular
requirements.description: Add Logo for reversible shall use the same flow/behavior as the regular uniform.

requirements.title: Duplicate to Side A/B link
requirements.description: A "Duplicate to Side A/B" link shall duplicate all applications from one side to the other side.

requirements.title: Duplicate application panel
requirements.description: Clicking the duplicate icon shall display the duplicate logo/text panel where the user chooses Side, then Location, then Part Location.

requirements.title: Duplicate Next adds to selected side
requirements.description: Clicking Next shall add the application to the tab of the selected Side.

requirements.title: Duplicate validation message
requirements.description: If the user clicks Next without selecting Side/Location/Part Location, a red validation message "Please select a Side/Location/Part Location." shall be displayed.

requirements.title: Add Pattern opens Add Patterns panel
requirements.description: Clicking the "Add Pattern" button at the bottom of the left panel shall change the left panel to the Add Patterns functionality.

requirements.title: Pattern locations multi-select
requirements.description: The Locations section shall show all available locations for a pattern and the user shall be able to select multiple locations.

requirements.title: Pattern Next shows pattern list
requirements.description: If a Location is selected, clicking Next shall display the Pattern list.

requirements.title: Pattern location validation
requirements.description: If no Location is selected, clicking Next shall display "Please select a Location."

requirements.title: Pattern Cancel returns to Colors
requirements.description: Clicking Cancel shall close the Pattern left panel and return to the Colors panel.

requirements.title: Pattern list applicable patterns
requirements.description: The Pattern list shall display all patterns applicable to the selected uniform.

requirements.title: Pattern single select
requirements.description: The user shall be able to select only one pattern at a time.

requirements.title: Pattern thumbnail applies to canvas
requirements.description: Clicking a pattern thumbnail shall apply the selected pattern to the uniform canvas.

requirements.title: Custom pattern removed
requirements.description: The Custom pattern option shall be removed for now (covered by BRD_Custom Pattern Functionality).

requirements.title: Pattern selection Next shows configuration
requirements.description: If a Pattern is selected, clicking Next shall display the pattern configuration panel.

requirements.title: Pattern selection validation
requirements.description: If no Pattern is selected, clicking Next shall display "Please select a Pattern."

requirements.title: Configure pattern details
requirements.description: The Configure Pattern panel shall show the Pattern Name, Pattern Thumbnail, Pattern Colors and Position.

requirements.title: Pattern thumbnail tooltip
requirements.description: Hovering over the Pattern Thumbnail shall display the tooltip "Click to update."

requirements.title: Pattern thumbnail returns to pattern page
requirements.description: Clicking the Pattern Thumbnail shall redirect to the previous Pattern page to update the applied pattern.

requirements.title: Pattern preselected colors from Colors In Use
requirements.description: Pre-selected pattern tile colors shall be based on Colors In Use.

requirements.title: Pattern color change via hover
requirements.description: The user shall change a pattern color by hovering the color tile and choosing from Colors in Use.

requirements.title: Pattern position slider
requirements.description: A slider shall let the user adjust the pattern position, with interactive "+" and "-" buttons adjusting by 1 unit.

requirements.title: Pattern Done
requirements.description: Clicking Done shall close the Pattern panel and display the Colors panel.

requirements.title: Pattern Remove
requirements.description: Clicking Remove shall remove the applied pattern from the uniform canvas and close the Add Pattern panel.

requirements.title: Colors panel pattern rows
requirements.description: The Colors panel shall list the parts where patterns are applied as Part Name, Pattern Name and Pattern Tile.

requirements.title: Pattern tile actions
requirements.description: Clicking the Pattern tile shall show the pattern colors, a Remove Pattern button and an Edit Pattern button, and allow color change.

requirements.title: Remove Pattern restores color
requirements.description: Remove Pattern shall remove the pattern from the uniform and replace the pattern tile with the previously selected color.

requirements.title: Edit Pattern returns to panel
requirements.description: Edit Pattern shall return the user to the Edit Pattern panel.

requirements.title: Edit Pattern update options
requirements.description: In the Edit Pattern panel the user shall be able to update the pattern by changing colors, position or the pattern itself.

requirements.title: Edit Pattern delete icon
requirements.description: In the Edit Pattern panel the user shall be able to remove the pattern via the delete icon.

requirements.title: Pattern delete resets body color 1
requirements.description: When the pattern is deleted from Edit Pattern, the body part in the Colors panel shall automatically have Color 1 as its color.

requirements.title: Pattern delete closes panel
requirements.description: After deleting from Edit Pattern, the Pattern panel shall automatically close and return to the Colors panel.

requirements.title: Edit Pattern Done
requirements.description: Clicking Done shall close the Edit Pattern panel.

requirements.title: Edit Pattern Cancel
requirements.description: Clicking Cancel shall cancel the edit-pattern action.

requirements.title: Patterns independent entities
requirements.description: Once applied, patterns shall be independent entities: editing/removing a pattern for one part shall not affect other patterns.

requirements.title: Add Piping opens panel
requirements.description: Clicking "Add Piping" shall change the left panel to the Add Piping functionality.

requirements.title: Piping location list
requirements.description: The Location section shall show all available locations where piping can be applied.

requirements.title: Piping type message by product type
requirements.description: A message below Location shall indicate the piping type, hardcoded: Tackle Twill = physical, Sublimated = sublimated, Hybrid = sublimated, e.g. "Piping on this item is sublimated."

requirements.title: Stock products no piping
requirements.description: Stock products shall have no piping (N/A).

requirements.title: Piping default no selection
requirements.description: The piping default state shall have no selections.

requirements.title: Piping multi-select
requirements.description: The user shall be able to select multiple pipings.

requirements.title: Piping auto-expand
requirements.description: Selecting a piping shall automatically expand it for configuration and keep it expanded while the location is selected.

requirements.title: Piping configuration fields
requirements.description: Piping configuration shall include Size and Colors, with Color 2 and Color 3 shown below Color 1 if the user chooses 2 or 3 colors.

requirements.title: Piping Done
requirements.description: Clicking Done shall close the Piping panel and display the Colors panel.

requirements.title: Piping Remove All unselects
requirements.description: Clicking Remove All shall unselect all selected pipings.

requirements.title: Piping Remove All clears canvas
requirements.description: Remove All shall remove all selected pipings from the uniform canvas.

requirements.title: Colors panel piping rows
requirements.description: The Colors panel shall list applied pipings as Piping Name, Size and number of colors.

requirements.title: Piping expandable in Colors panel
requirements.description: Piping in the Colors panel shall be expandable (chevron) and configurable from the expanded section.

requirements.title: Remove Piping button
requirements.description: The user shall be able to remove a piping via the Remove Piping button.

requirements.title: Applications grouped by body part
requirements.description: The Applications tab shall group applications by body part and show the value and application type.

requirements.title: Application row hover icons
requirements.description: Hovering an application shall display duplicate, remove and grip dots icons with tooltips (Duplicate, Delete, Adjust Layering).

requirements.title: Duplicate selects part
requirements.description: Clicking Duplicate shall open the Part selection; clicking a part shall display Part Location for selection.

requirements.title: Duplicate Next configures application
requirements.description: Clicking Next in duplicate shall open the application configuration with default values equal to the original application.

requirements.title: Duplicate naming
requirements.description: Once done, the duplicated application shall be named "{Application Type} {space} {2}" (e.g. Team Name 2).

requirements.title: Remove application
requirements.description: The user shall be able to remove an application via the remove icon.

requirements.title: Grip dots reorder within group
requirements.description: The user shall be able to drag applications up/down within their group via grip dots and not move them to other groups.

requirements.title: Application click opens edit panel
requirements.description: Clicking an application shall open its edit panel.

requirements.title: Floating tools on canvas
requirements.description: While editing an application, the canvas shall show floating tools (Delete, Rotate, Move, Resize) for the application being edited.

requirements.title: Hard limit disables Add Text/Logo
requirements.description: If the maximum number of allowed applications is reached, the Add Text and Add Logo buttons shall be disabled.

requirements.title: Reversible hard limit disables duplicate
requirements.description: For reversible, if the maximum is reached or duplicating to the other side would exceed it, the Duplicate to Side A/B option shall be disabled.

requirements.title: Soft limit informational modals removed
requirements.description: Informational modals related to the soft limit shall no longer be displayed.

requirements.title: Soft limit canvas price auto update
requirements.description: The pricing on the canvas shall automatically update to reflect additional soft-limit charges.

requirements.title: Soft limit summary add-on
requirements.description: The Summary tab shall automatically display the additional soft-limit add-on and its charge.

requirements.title: Application location soft limit message
requirements.description: The message shall read "{n} application locations are included on this item. Additional application locations are available for {$0.00} each."

requirements.title: Location soft limit modals removed
requirements.description: Informational modals related to the application location soft limit shall no longer be displayed.

requirements.title: Location soft limit canvas price
requirements.description: The canvas price shall automatically update for additional application location charges.

requirements.title: Location soft limit summary
requirements.description: The Summary tab shall automatically display the additional application location add-on and charge.

requirements.title: Team name panel header
requirements.description: The Edit Team Name Application panel header shall display the Application Type with the Body Part beside it.

requirements.title: Team name text field
requirements.description: The panel shall provide an Application Name (Team Name) text field.

requirements.title: Team name Accent dropdown
requirements.description: The panel shall provide an Accent dropdown, placed below the application name field.

requirements.title: Team name Base Type
requirements.description: The panel shall provide a Base Type dropdown with Solid Color and Pattern options.

requirements.title: Team name application colors
requirements.description: Application Colors items (Base Color, Outline 1, Outline 2, Shadow) shall vary by selected accent, changed via color tile, selecting only from Colors In Use.

requirements.title: Team name Font dropdown
requirements.description: The panel shall provide a Font dropdown.

requirements.title: Team name Layout dropdown
requirements.description: The panel shall provide a Layout dropdown.

requirements.title: Tailsweep dropdown
requirements.description: The panel shall provide a Tailsweep dropdown.

requirements.title: Tailsweep size
requirements.description: Tailsweep Size shall have a slider with interactive "+"/"-" buttons adjusting by 1 unit.

requirements.title: Tailsweep position
requirements.description: Tailsweep Position shall have sliders for up/down and left/right with "+"/"-" buttons adjusting by 1 unit.

requirements.title: Tailsweep rotation
requirements.description: Tailsweep Rotation shall provide horizontal flip, vertical flip and an angle adjustment the user can also type.

requirements.title: Team name size
requirements.description: Size shall have a slider with "+"/"-" buttons adjusting by 1 unit.

requirements.title: Team name position
requirements.description: Position shall have up/down and left/right sliders with "+"/"-" buttons adjusting by 1 unit.

requirements.title: Team name rotation
requirements.description: Rotation shall provide horizontal flip, vertical flip and a typeable angle adjustment.

requirements.title: Team name alignment
requirements.description: Alignment shall provide horizontal alignment, vertical alignment and a preset for Position configuration.

requirements.title: Team name Done
requirements.description: Done shall add the application to the list.

requirements.title: Team name Cancel
requirements.description: Cancel shall discard changes and return to the Application tab.

requirements.title: Player number panel header
requirements.description: The Edit Player Number panel header shall display the Application Type with the Body Part beside it.

requirements.title: Apply styling to all Player Numbers link
requirements.description: A clickable "Apply styling to all Player Numbers" link shall apply the style of the Player Number to all other player number applications (all or nothing).

requirements.title: Player numbers consistent styling
requirements.description: If the uniform has 2 or more Player Numbers, they shall have the same number, font, layout, accent and colors.

requirements.title: Player number text field
requirements.description: The panel shall provide an Application Name (Player Number) text field.

requirements.title: Player number link icon
requirements.description: A link icon shall indicate "All player numbers on a jersey display the same number".

requirements.title: Player number sync value
requirements.description: A new Player Number application shall automatically have the same number, and updating the number shall update all player number applications.

requirements.title: Player number Accent
requirements.description: The panel shall provide an Accent dropdown.

requirements.title: Player number Base Type
requirements.description: The panel shall provide a Base Type dropdown with Solid Color and Pattern.

requirements.title: Player number application colors
requirements.description: Application Colors (Base Color, Outline 1, Outline 2, Shadow) shall depend on the accent and select only from Colors In Use.

requirements.title: Player number Font
requirements.description: The panel shall provide a Font dropdown.

requirements.title: Player number size
requirements.description: Size shall have a slider with "+"/"-" buttons adjusting by 1 unit.

requirements.title: Player number position
requirements.description: Position shall have up/down and left/right sliders with "+"/"-" buttons.

requirements.title: Player number rotation
requirements.description: Rotation shall provide horizontal/vertical flip and typeable angle.

requirements.title: Player number alignment
requirements.description: Alignment shall provide horizontal, vertical alignment and a Position preset.

requirements.title: Player number Done
requirements.description: Done shall add the application to the list.

requirements.title: Player number Cancel
requirements.description: Cancel shall discard changes and return to the Application tab.

requirements.title: Player name panel header
requirements.description: The Edit Player Name panel header shall display the Application Type with the Body Part beside it.

requirements.title: Player name text field
requirements.description: The panel shall provide an Application Name (Player Name) text field.

requirements.title: Player name Accent
requirements.description: The panel shall provide an Accent dropdown.

requirements.title: Player name Base Type
requirements.description: The panel shall provide a Base Type dropdown with Solid Color and Pattern.

requirements.title: Player name application colors
requirements.description: Application Colors (Base Color, Outline 1, Outline 2, Shadow) shall depend on the accent and select only from Colors In Use.

requirements.title: Player name Font
requirements.description: The panel shall provide a Font dropdown.

requirements.title: Player name Layout
requirements.description: The panel shall provide a Layout dropdown.

requirements.title: Player name size
requirements.description: Size shall have a slider with "+"/"-" buttons adjusting by 1 unit.

requirements.title: Player name position
requirements.description: Position shall have up/down and left/right sliders with "+"/"-" buttons.

requirements.title: Player name rotation
requirements.description: Rotation shall provide horizontal/vertical flip and typeable angle.

requirements.title: Player name alignment
requirements.description: Alignment shall provide horizontal, vertical alignment and a Position preset.

requirements.title: Player name Done
requirements.description: Done shall add the application to the list.

requirements.title: Player name Cancel
requirements.description: Cancel shall discard changes and return to the Application tab.

requirements.title: Add Text panel header and close
requirements.description: The Add Text panel shall have an "Add Text" header and an "X" button to close it.

requirements.title: Text Type options
requirements.description: Text Type shall offer Team Name (Same On Every Item), Player Name (Set In Roster), Player Number (Set In Roster) and Graduation Year (Set In Roster).

requirements.title: Text Type collapses to dropdown
requirements.description: Once a Text Type is selected, other options shall disappear and the field shall change to a dropdown allowing modification.

requirements.title: Part selection section
requirements.description: After a Text Type is selected a Part section shall be displayed; once a Part is selected, other options disappear and the field becomes a dropdown.

requirements.title: Part Location selection
requirements.description: A Part Location section shall be displayed after Part; once selected, the Add application panel shall be displayed.

requirements.title: Add Text validation message
requirements.description: If Next is clicked without a selection, a red message "Please select a Text Type/Part/Part Location." shall be displayed.

requirements.title: Text base pattern panel
requirements.description: Selecting Pattern as Base Type shall display the Text Base Pattern panel where the user selects a pattern.

requirements.title: Text base pattern Next
requirements.description: After selecting a pattern, clicking Next shall proceed to the configure text base pattern panel.

requirements.title: Text base pattern validation
requirements.description: If no pattern is selected and Next is clicked, the message "Please select a Pattern." shall be displayed.

requirements.title: Configure text base pattern details
requirements.description: The configure panel shall show Pattern Name, Pattern Thumbnail, Pattern Colors and Position.

requirements.title: Text base thumbnail tooltip
requirements.description: Hovering the Pattern Thumbnail shall show the tooltip "Click to update."

requirements.title: Text base thumbnail redirect
requirements.description: Clicking the Pattern Thumbnail shall redirect to the previous Pattern page to update the applied pattern.

requirements.title: Text base preselected colors
requirements.description: Pre-selected pattern tile colors shall be based on Colors In Use and changeable by hovering the tile.

requirements.title: Text base position slider
requirements.description: A slider with "+"/"-" buttons adjusting by 1 unit shall adjust pattern position.

requirements.title: Text base Done
requirements.description: Done shall close the Text Base Pattern panel, return to application settings and change Base Type from "Solid Color" to "Pattern" with the pattern name and tile.

requirements.title: Text base Remove
requirements.description: Remove shall close the Text Base Pattern panel and remove the applied text base pattern from the canvas.

requirements.title: Edit text base pattern via section
requirements.description: In Edit application the user shall be able to Edit/Remove the pattern via the Pattern section and change pattern colors by hovering the tile.

requirements.title: Remove Pattern button on application
requirements.description: Remove Pattern shall remove the pattern from the uniform canvas.

requirements.title: Edit Pattern button opens settings
requirements.description: Edit Pattern shall open the Text Base Pattern settings panel.

requirements.title: Edit text base pattern options
requirements.description: In Edit Pattern the user shall be able to update the pattern (colors, position or pattern) or remove it via the delete icon.

requirements.title: Text base pattern delete resets color
requirements.description: When the pattern is deleted from Edit, the body part in the Colors panel shall automatically have Color 1 as its color and the panel shall close back to Colors panel.

requirements.title: Edit Text Base Pattern Done
requirements.description: Done shall close the Edit Text Base Pattern panel.

requirements.title: Text base Remove confirmation modal
requirements.description: Clicking Remove shall remove the applied pattern from the application and show a confirmation modal.

requirements.title: Add Logo panel header and close
requirements.description: The Add Logo panel shall have an "Add Logo" header and an "X" close button.

requirements.title: Add logo Part selection
requirements.description: A Part section shall be displayed; once selected, other options disappear and the field becomes a dropdown.

requirements.title: Add logo Part Location
requirements.description: A Part Location section shall be displayed; once selected, Next shall display the current Vectorsoft modal to select a logo.

requirements.title: Logo added to canvas after selection
requirements.description: After selecting a logo from the Design Studio modal, the user shall be redirected to the add logo panel and the logo shall already be added in the canvas.

requirements.title: Logo panel subheader
requirements.description: The Add Logo panel subheader shall show the logo name with the Body Part beside it.

requirements.title: Logo panel icons
requirements.description: Icons shall be available for Edit, View PDF Ready File and Download file.

requirements.title: Logo Edit opens Design Studio
requirements.description: Clicking Edit shall open the Design Studio modal.

requirements.title: Change Logo
requirements.description: Clicking Change Logo shall open the Design Studio modal.

requirements.title: Change Logo updates canvas and panel
requirements.description: Once the logo is changed, the style canvas and the logo in the left panel shall be dynamically updated.

requirements.title: View Art Details
requirements.description: View Art Details shall open the art details modal.

requirements.title: Logo Download svg
requirements.description: Download shall download the logo file as an SVG (same as Save As functionality).

requirements.title: Logo size
requirements.description: Size shall have a slider with "+"/"-" buttons adjusting by 1 unit.

requirements.title: Logo position
requirements.description: Position shall have up/down and left/right sliders with "+"/"-" buttons.

requirements.title: Logo rotation
requirements.description: Rotation shall provide horizontal/vertical flip and typeable angle.

requirements.title: Logo alignment
requirements.description: Alignment shall provide horizontal, vertical alignment and a Position preset.

requirements.title: Logo opacity
requirements.description: Opacity shall default to 100% and the user can also type the percentage.

requirements.title: Roster sizes sections
requirements.description: The Roster tab shall show Adult Sizes (How to measure link, Inseam Guide link, Available Sizes) and Youth Sizes.

requirements.title: Player Numbers section
requirements.description: The Roster tab shall have a Player Numbers section including "/" as no number.

requirements.title: Player Numbers Clear all
requirements.description: The Player Numbers section shall have a Clear all control.

requirements.title: Add Range opens fields
requirements.description: Clicking Add Range shall open the Add Range entry fields for a starting and ending number.

requirements.title: Add Range excludes Custom Number
requirements.description: Add Range shall exclude the Custom Number option; users select only predefined ranges and numbers added via Add Additional Number.

requirements.title: Add Range custom warning
requirements.description: If a Custom number is included in Add Range, the warning "Custom numbers can't be added using Add Range. Please select them individually." shall be displayed.

requirements.title: Add Range Submit
requirements.description: Submit shall add the specified range to the available Player Number options and automatically add the selected range to the roster.

requirements.title: Add Range Cancel
requirements.description: Cancel shall close the range entry fields without saving changes.

requirements.title: Additional Options expands
requirements.description: Clicking Additional Options shall expand additional configuration options.

requirements.title: Add 0 before single digits toggle
requirements.description: The "Add 0 before single digits" toggle shall add a zero to all single-digit player numbers (0-9).

requirements.title: Zero toggle updates roster entries
requirements.description: If single-digit numbers are already in the roster, their entries shall be updated automatically by the toggle.

requirements.title: Add More Numbers fields
requirements.description: Clicking Add More Numbers shall open the Additional Number range entry fields.

requirements.title: Additional numbers skip duplicates
requirements.description: On Submit, a number already in the Player Number list shall be skipped to prevent duplicates.

requirements.title: Additional numbers persist
requirements.description: Newly added numbers shall remain available in the line row until manually removed.

requirements.title: Remove additional number via X
requirements.description: Users shall be able to remove additional numbers by clicking the "X" button next to the number.

requirements.title: Remove unused number immediately
requirements.description: If the number is not used in the roster, it shall be removed immediately from the Player Number list.

requirements.title: Remove used number confirmation modal
requirements.description: If the number is assigned to roster entries, a confirmation modal shall be displayed before removal.

requirements.title: Remove number modal Cancel
requirements.description: Cancel shall close the modal without changes.

requirements.title: Remove Number action
requirements.description: Remove Number shall remove the number from the Player Number list and from all affected roster entries.

requirements.title: Add Custom Number fields
requirements.description: Clicking Add Custom Number shall open the Custom Number entry field.

requirements.title: Custom number info tooltip
requirements.description: An information icon shall display the tooltip "Any combination of 3 numbers, letters, or special characters".

requirements.title: Custom number Submit
requirements.description: Submit shall automatically add the custom player numbers to the roster.

requirements.title: Custom number Cancel
requirements.description: Cancel shall close the entry fields without saving changes.

requirements.title: Custom entry fields auto-close
requirements.description: Clicking Submit or Cancel shall automatically close the entry fields.

requirements.title: Custom numbers separate entities
requirements.description: Each Custom Number added shall be treated as a separate number entity in the roster.

requirements.title: Custom number duplicates allowed
requirements.description: A Custom Number may duplicate an existing roster number; duplicates are allowed and treated as separate entries.

requirements.title: Advanced Application Sizing modal
requirements.description: Advanced Application Sizing shall open a modal with Cancel and Save Application Sizes buttons.

requirements.title: Advanced Application Sizing reversible
requirements.description: A reversible-specific Advanced Application Sizing modal shall be provided.

requirements.title: Player Name Title Casing icons
requirements.description: Clickable icons for Upper Case (TT), Title Case (Tt) and Lower Case (tt) shall apply the capitalization format to player names.

requirements.title: Total Quantity and Roster Subtotal
requirements.description: The Roster tab shall show Total Quantity and Roster Subtotal, where the subtotal is the total of items only, excluding add-ons.

requirements.title: Roster table columns
requirements.description: The Roster table shall have columns Player # (from Player Numbers), Player Name (text), QTY (text), Group ID (text) and Actions.

requirements.title: Roster row duplicate icon
requirements.description: The Duplicate icon shall add a new item row with the same values.

requirements.title: Roster row remove icon
requirements.description: The Remove icon shall delete the item row.

requirements.title: Roster grouped by size
requirements.description: Roster items shall be grouped by sizes, each section showing the price per item and total qty of the size group.

requirements.title: Roster size group Clear all
requirements.description: Clear All shall remove all items within the size group including the sizes selected from the left panel.

requirements.title: Upload Roster modal
requirements.description: Upload Roster shall open a modal with Download Template, Choose File, Drag and Drop File, Apply to Roster and Cancel.

requirements.title: Remove uploaded file
requirements.description: The user shall be able to remove the uploaded file via the "x" button.

requirements.title: Copy Roster modal
requirements.description: Copy Roster shall open the Copy Roster modal.

requirements.title: Summary item subtotal
requirements.description: The Summary tab left panel shall show an Item Subtotal that is the total of items including add-ons.

requirements.title: Summary base price
requirements.description: Base Price shall show either MSRP or Brand/Dealer Cost in the format {Price} x {QTY} {Size}.

requirements.title: Summary add-on list
requirements.description: Add-ons shall be listed in the format {Price} x {QTY} items.

requirements.title: Summary add-on Edit button
requirements.description: Each add-on Edit button shall redirect to the section where it was configured (e.g. Remove Brand Logo edit goes to Colors panel brand logo dropdown).

requirements.title: Summary canvas final design
requirements.description: The Summary uniform canvas shall show the final design.

requirements.title: Summary canvas clickable parts
requirements.description: Parts and applications on the Summary canvas shall be clickable and redirect to the correct panel (e.g. application edit panel or edit logo).

requirements.title: Manual Order tab and toggle
requirements.description: A new Manual Order tab shall provide a Manual Order toggle switch, Design File, Notes and Steps.

requirements.title: Manual order main body color empty
requirements.description: When Manual Order is enabled, the Main Body Color field shall initially be empty with a "+" icon to open the Color Selection Modal.

requirements.title: Manual order color replaces plus
requirements.description: Once a color is selected, the "+" icon shall be replaced by the selected color name and tile.

requirements.title: Manual order color hover modal
requirements.description: Hovering the selected color tile shall display the Color Selection Modal to choose a different color.

requirements.title: Manual order MISSING ITEMS modal
requirements.description: When the user clicks Add to Cart and required selections are missing, a "MISSING ITEMS" modal shall appear.

requirements.title: Missing items dynamic message
requirements.description: The MISSING ITEMS message shall be dynamic by what is missing (Design File, Fabric Selection or Main Body Color), e.g. "MISSING ITEMS: Please add a design file before adding this item to your cart."

requirements.title: Open in New Tab for design file
requirements.description: "Open in New Tab" shall open the uploaded file in a new tab.

requirements.title: Notes button in header
requirements.description: A new Notes button shall be added alongside Undo, Redo and Help buttons.

requirements.title: Notes modal draggable
requirements.description: Clicking Notes shall show a draggable modal with Issues and Logs tabs, movable via grip dots.

requirements.title: Notes modal dismiss
requirements.description: The modal shall be dismissed with the "X" button.

requirements.title: Notes modal default location
requirements.description: When reopened, the Notes modal shall appear in its default location.

requirements.title: Issues tab content
requirements.description: The Issues tab shall display all System Updates and Design Requests that need to be resolved.

requirements.title: Logs tab content
requirements.description: The Logs tab shall display a consolidated history of System Updates and Design Requests.

requirements.title: Rework buttons replace Save and Add to Cart [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: When an item is tagged as a Rework, the Save and Add to Cart buttons shall be replaced with Cancel and Resolve and Submit when the builder opens. (Struck through in BRD v9.0.0: moved to a different ticket.)

requirements.title: Rework Cancel returns [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: Cancel shall return the user to the page from which the rework item was accessed. (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: Rework confirmation modal options [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: Resolve and Submit shall open a confirmation modal requiring one of: "I only made the changes listed in the rework notes" or "I made additional changes and will provide an explanation below". (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: Rework notes field disabled by default [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: The Notes field shall be disabled by default and when no option is selected. (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: Rework notes optional for first option [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: Selecting "I only made the changes..." shall enable the Notes field as optional. (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: Rework notes mandatory for second option [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: Selecting "I made additional changes..." shall enable the Notes field as mandatory. (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: Rework modal Cancel [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: Cancel in the confirmation modal shall close it without submitting. (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: Rework modal Resolve and Submit [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: Resolve and Submit shall submit the rework resolution and follow the existing Rework Process workflow. (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: Rework Notes modal auto-open [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: When the Builder opens for a Rework item, the Notes modal shall automatically open. (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: Rework Logs tab default [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: The Logs tab shall be selected by default with the Reworks section expanded. (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: View factory rework notes [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: The user shall be able to view the factory's rework notes including attachments. (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: View attachment via Eye icon [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: Clicking the Eye icon shall open the attachment in a separate browser tab. (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: Add rework notes and attachment [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: The user may optionally add notes and upload an attachment as part of the rework response. (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: View/remove uploaded attachment [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: An uploaded attachment shall be viewable via the Eye icon in a new tab and removable via the "X" button. (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: Rework history logged [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: Once submitted, all notes and attachments shall be logged under the Reworks section of the Logs tab. (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: Rework history appended [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: If the item is returned as a rework again, new notes and attachments shall be appended to the existing history. (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: Rework logs chronological [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: Rework logs shall be displayed in chronological order. (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: Rework auto-scroll to latest [struck through in v9.0.0]
requirements.description: The Reworks section shall automatically scroll to the latest rework entry when new history is added. (Struck through in v9.0.0.)

requirements.title: Pricing toggle Custom Pro fee
requirements.description: Pricing toggle shall govern the Custom Pro (Manual Order) Custom Pro Add-on Fee.

requirements.title: Pricing toggle Details prices
requirements.description: Pricing toggle shall govern the Youth and Adult Price in the Details tab.

requirements.title: Pricing toggle fabric fee
requirements.description: Pricing toggle shall govern the Fabric Upgrade and Downgrade Fee in the Options tab.

requirements.title: Pricing toggle No Logo fee
requirements.description: Pricing toggle shall govern the Brand Logo (No Logo) fee in the Customize tab.

requirements.title: Pricing toggle soft limit fee
requirements.description: Pricing toggle shall govern the Soft Limit fee in the Applications tab.

requirements.title: Pricing toggle roster
requirements.description: Pricing toggle shall govern the Roster Subtotal and MOQ by Item in the Roster tab.

requirements.title: Pricing toggle summary
requirements.description: Pricing toggle shall govern all prices in the Summary tab.

requirements.title: Pricing toggle canvas
requirements.description: Pricing toggle shall govern the Pricing Display on the canvas.

requirements.title: Zoom button in header
requirements.description: A new Zoom button shall be displayed in the header to access zoom functionality, behaving as in "Core Customizer: Zoom Feature on the Builder Canvas".

requirements.title: Zoom button position with Notes
requirements.description: When the style contains Notes, the Zoom button shall be positioned between the Redo and Notes buttons.

requirements.title: Copy roster includes additional and custom numbers
requirements.description: The user shall be able to copy all roster details including Additional Numbers and Custom Numbers.

requirements.title: MOQ modal on Add to Cart
requirements.description: When the user clicks Add to Cart and the minimum required quantity has not been met, a modal shall be displayed.

requirements.title: MOQ validation order
requirements.description: The existing validation flow shall be retained: if no player names are added the player name validation message shall show first; on clicking Add to Cart again the Minimum Order modal shall show if MOQ is not satisfied.

requirements.title: Stock hide Colors In Use picker
requirements.description: The "Colors in Use" color picker shall not be displayed for Stock products.

requirements.title: Stock body part color picker modal
requirements.description: The Body part shall have its own dedicated color picker modal for Stock products.

requirements.title: Stock picker shows only available colors
requirements.description: Hovering the Body color tile shall display the color picker modal showing only colors available for the selected Stock Product.

requirements.title: Stock hardcoded behavior retained
requirements.description: Existing hardcoded behavior for applicable stock styles shall remain unchanged.

requirements.title: Stock application color overlay plus
requirements.description: Hovering an Application color tile shall display the Colors in Use overlay with a "+" button.

requirements.title: Stock additional colors for application
requirements.description: Clicking "+" shall display the Additional Colors section with only colors available for the selected application.

requirements.title: Stock selected color applied and added
requirements.description: Selecting a color from Additional Colors shall apply it to the application and add it to Colors in Use.

requirements.title: Stock color removal affects other applications
requirements.description: Removing a color via "x" in Colors in Use shall also affect other applications' Colors In Use.

requirements.title: Stock Remove Color modal
requirements.description: If a color being removed is applied in other applications, the Remove Color modal shall be displayed (same as FR 6).

requirements.title: Application color overlay plus
requirements.description: For Sublimated, Twill and Hybrid, hovering an Application color tile shall display the Colors in Use overlay with a "+" button.

source.section: FR 28 Sublimated, Twill and Hybrid Product Changes

requirements.title: Additional Colors only for application
requirements.description: Clicking "+" shall display the Additional Colors section with only the colors available for the selected application.

source.section: FR 28 Sublimated, Twill and Hybrid Product Changes

requirements.title: Selected additional color applied
requirements.description: Selecting a color from Additional Colors shall apply it to the application and add it to Colors in Use.

source.section: FR 28 Sublimated, Twill and Hybrid Product Changes

requirements.title: Color removal affects other applications
requirements.description: Removing a color via "x" shall also affect other applications' Color In Use.

source.section: FR 28 Sublimated, Twill and Hybrid Product Changes

requirements.title: Remove Color modal for parts and apps
requirements.description: If the color is applied in parts and applications, the Remove Color modal shall be displayed (same as FR 6).

source.section: FR 28 Sublimated, Twill and Hybrid Product Changes

requirements.title: Team carried over to Picker
requirements.description: When the user adds a team from the Builder page, Organization dropdown or Add to Cart flow, the team shall be carried over to the Picker page and displayed as the selected team.

source.section: FR 29 Carryover of Team Name to Picker

requirements.title: Hide Add Pattern/Piping if not applicable
requirements.description: If adding a pattern or piping is not applicable, the corresponding button shall be hidden.

source.section: FR 30 Hide Add Pattern Piping Text Logo

requirements.title: Hide Application tab if not applicable
requirements.description: If adding text and logo is not applicable, the Application Tab shall be hidden.

source.section: FR 30 Hide Add Pattern Piping Text Logo

requirements.title: Center single applicable button
requirements.description: If only one button is applicable, it shall be center-aligned.

source.section: FR 30 Hide Add Pattern Piping Text Logo

requirements.title: Canvas discount strikethrough
requirements.description: If a Discount Code is applied in the shopping cart, the style canvas shall show the original price with strikethrough and the discounted price below it.

requirements.title: Canvas discount badge
requirements.description: A badge shall be shown below the canvas pricing information to indicate the discount association.

requirements.title: Details tab discount price
requirements.description: In the Details tab, the original price shall be struck through with the discounted price displayed next to it.

requirements.title: Summary tab discount price
requirements.description: In the Summary tab, the original price shall be struck through with the discounted price displayed below and next to it.

requirements.title: Admin can mark a color as Core Color
requirements.description: The Colors By Brand page (QX7 > Master Data > Colors > Colors By Brand) shall let a Brand/Admin mark a color as a "Core Color" (brand-recommended color).

source.file: brd/RD_Core Colors Toggle in Colors By Brand Page.docx

requirements.title: Core color toggle on index page
requirements.description: The Colors By Brand index page shall provide a core/recommended color toggle per color, similar to the existing active toggle (stakeholder potential solution).

source.file: brd/RD_Core Colors Toggle in Colors By Brand Page.docx
source.section: FR 1 Colors By Brand Index Page

requirements.title: Core color control on edit page
requirements.description: The Edit Color By Brand page shall provide a control to indicate whether the color is a Core Color (single-select dropdown per stakeholder suggestion).

source.file: brd/RD_Core Colors Toggle in Colors By Brand Page.docx

requirements.title: Colors picker classifies Core vs Additional
requirements.description: In the Customizer Reskin color picker modal (Colors In Use), Core Colors (brand-determined) shall be shown separately from Additional Colors (all other colors).
