requirements.title: Rework items highlighted in red On Hold
requirements.description: Items that need to be reworked shall be highlighted in red with status "On Hold".

requirements.title: Rework marked on Orders page
requirements.description: Reworks shall be clearly marked in red on the main Orders page.

requirements.title: Rework marked on Order view
requirements.description: Reworks shall be clearly marked in red on the Order view.

requirements.title: Rework marked on Item view
requirements.description: Reworks shall be clearly marked in red on the Item view.

requirements.title: Rework badge and label
requirements.description: Rework items shall always stand out with a badge and label.

requirements.title: Rejected item highlight and badge
requirements.description: Rejected items shall be highlighted (e.g. pink highlight) and display an "on hold" badge.

requirements.title: Rejected order stays in orders tab
requirements.description: A rejected order shall remain in the 'orders' tab.

requirements.title: Email alert on rejection
requirements.description: The system shall trigger an email alert upon rejection (rejection with notes from Artwork Production Site or Factory Production Site).

requirements.title: Orders menu rework count
requirements.description: The number shown in the ORDERS menu on the left side shall represent the number of reworks needed.

requirements.title: Fix Issue button opens Customizer
requirements.description: Clicking the Fix Issue button (from Orders, Order view, Item view or Email) shall open the Customizer on the selected item in the builder.

requirements.title: Fix Issue shows rework notes
requirements.description: Opening the Customizer from Fix Issue shall show the rework notes describing what needs to be changed.

requirements.title: Rework unlocks item for editing
requirements.description: A rework shall unlock the item for editing, and the Customizer shall be unlocked only during rework sessions.

requirements.title: Fix Issue also via order and item drawers
requirements.description: The Fix Issue action shall be available from the Order drawer and Item drawer (including On Hold in item drawer) with the same process.

requirements.title: End-user cannot see fix issue
requirements.description: The End-User shall not see the Fix Issue button/badge (sales rep handles the fix with their customer).

requirements.title: Prevail managing rep sees fix issue
requirements.description: In the Prevail brand, the managing Rep shall see the badge, Fix Issue button and highlight, as they can act on behalf of the sales rep.

requirements.title: Rework banner message
requirements.description: A banner shall show "Please update only the items specified in the rework notes. Additional edits require an explanation and may be rejected if not properly justified."

requirements.title: Additional change explanation text box
requirements.description: If the user makes changes not in the rework notes, a text box shall appear for them to write why they changed it.

requirements.title: QC accepts or rejects additional change
requirements.description: QC shall be able to accept a necessary additional change or reject a preference-only additional change.

requirements.title: Issues/Logs tab only on rework
requirements.description: A new Issues/Logs tab shall be added to the builder and shall only show if there is an issue to resolve (rework) on the item.

requirements.title: Issues and Logs subtabs
requirements.description: The Issues/Logs tab shall contain Issues and Logs sub-tabs.

requirements.title: Issues opening statement
requirements.description: The Issues sub tab shall show the opening statement "Fix the issue listed. When you are done, return to this section and submit your updates to the factory."

requirements.title: Issues contents System Updates Design Requests
requirements.description: System Updates and Design Requests shall be listed in the Issues tab with respective badges.

requirements.title: Issues rework badge and timestamp
requirements.description: The Issues tab shall show a Rework badge and a timestamp of when it was loaded in the builder.

requirements.title: Rework notes image in drawer only
requirements.description: The user shall be able to view the image in the rework notes within the drawer only.

requirements.title: Rework notes and attachments optional
requirements.description: The user shall be able to add optional notes and attachments to the rework response.

requirements.title: Logs sub tab contents
requirements.description: The Logs sub tab shall show Badge, Notes and dates for Rework, System Updates and Design Requests.

requirements.title: Logs list multiple reworks
requirements.description: If a single item has multiple reworks, they shall all be listed in the Logs sub tab.

requirements.title: Logs badge colors
requirements.description: System Update and Design Request badges in Logs shall follow the badge colors in the mock-up.

requirements.title: Resolved reworks in Logs
requirements.description: Resolved reworks shall be shown in the Logs area so users can look back on earlier reworks within the item.

requirements.title: No rejection removes opening statement
requirements.description: When there is no rejection, the "Fix the issue listed..." statement shall be removed.

requirements.title: Confirmation required to submit
requirements.description: Users cannot submit the rework until they have chosen one confirmation option.

requirements.title: Radio option one
requirements.description: The first radio option shall be "I only made the changes listed in the rework notes."

requirements.title: Radio option two
requirements.description: The second radio option shall be "I made additional changes and need to provide an explanation. This may affect pricing or delay production."

requirements.title: Option two shows notes field
requirements.description: Selecting the second option shall show an additional notes field.

requirements.title: Additional change notes only notifies artist
requirements.description: The additional-changes option only notifies the artist; displaying a real-time price change on the front end is not required.

requirements.title: Resolve and Submit requires notes
requirements.description: The Resolve & Submit button shall not proceed if the user provides no notes when required, and the notes field shall be highlighted in red.

requirements.title: Resolve and Submit opens modal
requirements.description: Clicking Resolve & Submit shall open a pop-up modal specific to the selected radio option.

requirements.title: Modal option two requires checkbox
requirements.description: For radio option 2, the user shall click the checkbox before clicking submit (required).

requirements.title: Modal Cancel and Submit
requirements.description: The modal shall offer Cancel (closes the modal) and Submit.

requirements.title: Submit redirects to Order Tracking
requirements.description: If the user submits, it shall go back to the Order Tracking page with a green notification in the right corner.

requirements.title: Submit returns item to workflow
requirements.description: Once submitted, the item shall return to the workflow with updated date stamps.

requirements.title: Notes always sent with submission
requirements.description: Notes shall always be sent with the submission.

requirements.title: Clear error states on failure
requirements.description: Clear error states shall be shown if submission fails (confirmation of only outlined changes, or justification for extra changes).

requirements.title: Submit saves new PDF
requirements.description: When Submit is clicked after changes, the front end shall save a new PDF with the updated selections and send it as an updated attachment tied to the same order ID to the factory side.

requirements.title: Reorder rework keeps locked tabs
requirements.description: If a rejection occurs on a reorder item, the customization panel tabs locked for the reorder shall remain locked.

requirements.title: Reorder rework removes additional-changes radio
requirements.description: For a rejection on a reorder item, the "I made additional changes" radio shall be removed.

requirements.title: Reorder rework resolved via notes
requirements.description: Resolution of a reorder rejection shall be handled solely through notes, attachments and the Resolve and Submit button.

requirements.title: Legacy item checkbox on price item
requirements.description: Price items (Finance > Price Items) shall have a checkbox indicating the price item is used for a legacy item.

requirements.title: Roster group field for legacy
requirements.description: When the legacy checkbox is true, a roster group field shall become available to select from existing Roster groups.

requirements.title: Quickstrike Item ID fields for legacy
requirements.description: When the legacy checkbox is true, Quickstrike Item ID fields shall become available, copying the format and fields of the Qstrike Item ID modal (one open field per brand item ID and size group).

requirements.title: Add multiple Quickstrike ID groups
requirements.description: A + button under the Quickstrike Item ID fields shall add another group of Quickstrike item ID fields to tie several legacy items to the same price item.

requirements.title: Fabric selection grayed out for legacy
requirements.description: For legacy price items the fabric selection shall be grayed out, with one pricing table still available to set the prices for the reorder item.

requirements.title: Downloadable PDF for legacy
requirements.description: If a downloadable PDF exists for a legacy item, users shall be able to download it as normal.

requirements.title: No PDF option hidden
requirements.description: If a PDF is not available, the download option shall not be available.

requirements.title: Missing legacy data omitted
requirements.description: If legacy item data is missing, the corresponding field shall not appear in the UI.

requirements.title: Invoice Number optional column
requirements.description: "Invoice Number" shall be an optional column in the Orders page column adder to help identify Legacy items.

requirements.title: Legacy thumbnail with badge
requirements.description: If a thumbnail exists, it shall display normally with a "Legacy Item" badge in the top-left corner of the item row on the Orders page.

requirements.title: Legacy placeholder when no thumbnail
requirements.description: If no thumbnail exists, the thumbnail area shall be replaced with a "Legacy Item" placeholder and the badge shall still appear.

requirements.title: Order drawer condensed layout
requirements.description: The Order drawer shall omit fields missing from legacy data while keeping the layout condensed and clean.

requirements.title: Item view legacy
requirements.description: The Item view shall tolerate missing information, disable the View PDF button when no PDF is available, and show the legacy badge and placeholder image.

requirements.title: Reorder Legacy Item modal
requirements.description: Clicking REORDER ITEM for a legacy item shall open a modal with header "Reorder Legacy Item", Cancel and Reorder Item buttons.

requirements.title: Reorder Legacy modal wording
requirements.description: The modal wording shall be "This item was created in an older system, so a preview of the design isn't available. If you continue, your order will be produced using the same specifications from the original order."

requirements.title: Proceed to roster and cart
requirements.description: If the user selects Reorder Item, they shall be able to add a roster (if needed) and add the item to their cart.

requirements.title: Deletion request flow
requirements.description: The factory requests deletion of a legacy reorder item; the request is reviewed by Dan Mullins and Devri Christensen and the item is deleted once confirmed it cannot be fulfilled (in existing factory system).

requirements.title: Deletion reason pulled from factory
requirements.description: The deletion reason from the factory system may be used to provide the message shown in the customizer.

requirements.title: Deletion email to user
requirements.description: The user shall receive an email explaining the deletion using the note entered by Dan or Devri, triggered when Delete is clicked in the factory production site.

requirements.title: Deleted item grayed out with badge
requirements.description: Deleted items shall appear grayed out on the Orders page with a red "Deleted" status badge.

requirements.title: Deleted item limited info
requirements.description: Deleted items shall show limited information: item picture, item name, Org and Web Order #.

requirements.title: View Issue button on hover
requirements.description: A "View Issue" button shall appear on hover for deleted items (same placement as "Fix Issue").

requirements.title: Web Order # clickable on deleted
requirements.description: The Web Order # shall remain clickable on a deleted item, and the order drawer and item drawer shall still be viewable.

requirements.title: View Issue opens Logs tab
requirements.description: View Issue shall open the customizer to the Issues/Logs tab, showing the Logs tab.

requirements.title: Deletion note with timestamp
requirements.description: The customizer shall display the deletion note with a timestamp.

requirements.title: No Resolve and Submit for deleted
requirements.description: There shall be no "Resolve and Submit" action for a deleted item (permanently deleted).

requirements.title: View Issue access points
requirements.description: "View Issue" shall be accessible from the Orders list, Order view, Item view and directly from the email.

requirements.title: Deleted items restore allotments
requirements.description: Deleted items shall restore the allotments for the associated part that was deleted.
